visualCharacteristics: Borderless key/value fact sheet. Each row is a label/value pair separated by a thin horizontal divider; labels are uppercase in a muted grey, values are bold in the text color. No header row.
contentPattern: Rows of two cells with no header row: cell 1 is the label (e.g. 'Activity'), cell 2 is the value (e.g. 'Surfing').
usage: Adventure detail fact sheet listing activity, trip length, group size, difficulty, price, etc.
